question: What happens if no response is received after an elapsed PCF interframe space during the contention-free period? [IEEE 802.11]
options: The access point moves to the next station on its polling list
The access point ends the contention-free period
The medium is released and becomes available for DCF-based access
The access point sends a CF-End frame to signal the end of the contention-free period
The access point transmits a Beacon frame to reserve the medium
correct_answer: The access point moves to the next station on its polling list

question: What are the three components involved in the procedure of wireless network connectivity? [IEEE 802.11]
options: Locating a compatible network, authenticating mobile stations, and associating with an access point
Transmitting PS-Poll frames, updating the NAV, and finding frames buffered for a mobile station
Establishing the identity of a network station, updating the NAV, and synchronizing the transmission of ACK frames
Creating the MAC header, using fixed fields and information elements, and assembling management frames
Inspecting the BSSID, using the Duration field, and transmitting management frames
correct_answer: Locating a compatible network, authenticating mobile stations, and associating with an access point

The UE initiates the release procedure
The eNB triggers the release over the S5 interface

Based on the operator configuration

question: What happens when a switch receives a GMRP join message? [TCP/IP]
options: The switch adds the sender's IP address to the relevant multicast group
The switch adds the port on which it received the message to the relevant multicast group
The switch forwards the message to all other participants in the VLAN
The switch forwards the message only to the members of the multicast group
The switch deletes the participant from the list
correct_answer: The switch adds the port on which it received the message to the relevant multicast group

To send error messages about network features and host availability
To send a reply message with all required information to the requesting participant

question: What is the mapping function for determining the RAW slot index? [IEEE 802.11]
